create_multi_corpus_dataset: create a MultiCorpusDataset from an OrderedDict of FairseqDataset instances with a sampling distribution
generate_ordered_indices: generate shuffled sampled indices across multiple datasets using a specified probability distribution and seed
map_dataset_index: map a combined dataset index to its original dataset key and local index using _map_index
batch_by_size_per_dataset: batch indices by size per dataset separately when batch_sample is enabled for single-dataset batches
review_multicorpus_collation: review the MultiCorpusDataset collater method to understand how it routes samples to the correct dataset collater
